title: Tyler Shough: We can't let Gayle Benson's comments affect our daily process

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Tyler Shough: We can't let Gayle Benson's comments affect our daily process
sources.description: Saints owner Gayle Benson's decision to publicly air her frustrations about the team's 1-4 start earlier this week drew a lot of attention because of how blunt she was about her disappointment and how rarely she shares her views about the state of the franchise.
